question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Persuasion, Bob gets Dune, Claire gets The Trial, Dave gets Dracula, and Eve gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Dave swap books. Then, Eve and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Eve swap books. Finally, Claire and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Persuasion
(B) Dune
(C) The Trial
(D) Dracula
(E) Ivanhoe
solution:
Each row lists the books held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve, in that order.
Initial: Persuasion | Dune | The Trial | Dracula | Ivanhoe
After Alice–Eve: Ivanhoe | Dune | The Trial | Dracula | Persuasion
After Claire–Dave: Ivanhoe | Dune | Dracula | The Trial | Persuasion
After Eve–Claire: Ivanhoe | Dune | Persuasion | The Trial | Dracula
After Bob–Eve: Ivanhoe | Dracula | Persuasion | The Trial | Dune
After Claire–Alice: Persuasion | Dracula | Ivanhoe | The Trial | Dune
Bob has Dracula, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
